style: Soft painterly illustration in gouache and watercolour, with gentle brush texture and a calm, quiet mood. Warm paper tones that sit harmoniously with the app's paper colour #FAF7F2 and Selah green #2F5D4A: cream, sage, sand, soft ochre and a touch of terracotta. Low contrast, plenty of open space, no hard outlines. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image, and no faces of Jesus (no human faces at all where possible; figures are seen from behind or in silhouette).
